question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you like chemistry?
options: No way, I'd rather go to lunch.

question_options.question: Have you ever failed a test?

nodes.text: Sam throws the beaker at Colt! Ben snatches it out of mid-air!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh!
Sam hurls a test tube at Colt, and Ben dives to catch it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can you quit it?
Mr. Russell approaches.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: What is going on over here? Are you `juggling` your acids and bases?
nodes.text_bbcode: What is going on over here? Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]juggling[/i][/color] your acids and bases?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, no, sir. Of course not.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Because that would be incredibly stupid and very dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, sir!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: I hope I don't have to remind you that throwing chemicals in lab can earn you a week of detention.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, sir.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: All right. Carry on.
Mr. Russell leaves the group, and everyone sighs with relief.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, you guys! That was close! Just relax already.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just tell that to my crazy girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not your girlfriend anymore, you sleaze ball.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Can everyone just stop yelling? I know everything's my fault...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you'd thrown that beaker, Sam, you could've burned down the entire chem lab, and we could've been suspended.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, none of us are going to pass if we don't work together. I think we've all learned a valuable lesson here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What's got your goat, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm having trouble in lab class. Mainly, with my lab partners.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Say no more, I understand. I got Amanda in my lab group once... It was a disaster. She kept mixing things together thinking they would make pink.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Blue and green don't make pink, and acids and bases should never be mixed in large quantities.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, it's nothing like that. Remember what I said about the guy who cheated on his girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All three of them are in my lab group.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sam, Colt, and Denni?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You know what they say about volatile substances... Neutralize them. If you want that 'A' in Russell's class, you need to go to each of them and fix them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't want to interfere with their lives, Dex. Besides, I don't know if I can.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dex does bring up a good point. It's either you help everyone deal with the break up or try to brave that lab test on your own.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: After what happened today...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know what I need to do.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's a lie. Everyone wants to be popular.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And if not popular, at least liked.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, maybe I just have other things to focus on right now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hasn't everyone?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I have to admit, it would be easier to get my short stories published in the newspaper if I had more backing from someone like Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I doubt it's going to happen to me soon. I have other things to focus on right now.
Sam throws the beaker! Colt ducks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Avoid exposure to eyes and skin!
Ben watches the beaker break and spill onto the table. The acid starts eating into the desk with a loud hiss!
Mr. Russell runs over with a bucket of baking soda and neutralizes the acid!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Someone give me an explanation. `Now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Someone give me an explanation. [color=#e23b3b][i]Now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I might have thrown that beaker...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Not `again.` What is it with you two and lab accidents?
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#e23b3b][i]again.[/i][/color] What is it with you two and lab accidents?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: I should report you to Shapiro for this incident, but it's clear all of you are having a difficult day.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: I don't know exactly what's going on, and I think you're old enough to talk it through.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: But come test day, if you're issues aren't resolved, you are all going to fail!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Now you're going to stay during lunch and clean up this mess, no matter how long it takes.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes, sir.
After class, the lab group glumly cleans up their station. Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This sucks. Lunch is the only `good` time of the day. I don't want to be stuck in lab ever again.
nodes.text_bbcode: This sucks. Lunch is the only [color=#e23b3b][i]good[/i][/color] time of the day. I don't want to be stuck in lab ever again.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, that's good. I think we all learned a valuable lesson here today.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on, Sammy. Don't make a big deal out of this. It was an accident.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Accident?!` How do you `accidentally` kiss someone?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Accident?![/i][/color] How do you [color=#3b78e2][i]accidentally[/i][/color] kiss someone?!

nodes.text: Just then, the bell rings, and Mr. Russell clears his throat at the head of the room.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: I want to remind you there are only three more days until the final lab test.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: I hope you also remember that this lab test will be worth fifty percent of your score. A failing mark could bring your grade down an entire letter.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: So work well with your partners today and make sure you're all confident about your ability to pass the test.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: For today, I'm giving you a practice lab. Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, guys, heh. Now that that's over with, can we put all the nasty drama behind us and work together?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine.
For the next twenty minutes, the group tries to work.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sam, can you hand me Beaker 2?
Sam slides the beaker over with too much force. It topples over on the countertop.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... Maybe we'll start with Beaker 3. Denni?
Denni tries to pass her beaker over, but its contents spill over the sides.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry, my hands are a little shaky.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's okay. Colt, can you give me those pH strips?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I don't really do this 'teamwork' thing. Ask my girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Your girlfriend? After what you did?!
Ben ducks as Sam throws a pencil at Colt!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You pig!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now, isn't that just a little undeserved?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I feel really bad about what I did! It's all my fault!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What else can I tell you? The kiss was an accident!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait! Guys, what about the lab test? I don't want to...
Denni and Ben duck as Sam hurls her backpack at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Accident?!` I'll show you an accident!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Accident?![/i][/color] I'll show you an accident!

nodes.text: Sam reaches for a beaker full of chemicals!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sam, don't do it. Don't throw the universal indicator! Put it down! `Put it down!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, don't do it. Don't throw the universal indicator! Put it down! [color=#e23b3b][i]Put it down![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben. I just need to get this off my chest.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just know that if I tell `someone`, I'll be able to concentrate.
nodes.text_bbcode: I just know that if I tell [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color], I'll be able to concentrate.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Back when Principal Dyre was here, he put me in detention with Colt, Taylor, and Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That must've been weird.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, but the weird part is actually that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Colt and I kissed!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Colt and I kissed![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `That's` what I thought.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] what I thought.

nodes.text: Ben and Denni whirl around to see Sam and Colt!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So the rumors were true, Colt. I just had to hear it from one of you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just wait a minute!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe this! We're through!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, okay. I got it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, it's just that this might not be the `best` time...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, it's just that this might not be the [color=#e23b3b][i]best[/i][/color] time...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I said, I got it, Ben.
Sam and Colt walk in the door.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm really excited we're going to the beach this weekend.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah...
Sam and Colt sit down at Ben and Denni's table and pull out their notebooks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Colt, I couldn't figure out the answer for problem three. What did you do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I didn't do anything! I mean, it's just a kiss. It's not like we made out or anything!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `What are you talking about?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What are you talking about?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's all my fault. I'm sorry, Sam. I kissed Colt!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I'll deal with `you` later. Colt, explain!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'll deal with [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] later. Colt, explain!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe this! We're through!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Colt taught you that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yep! You know him?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's in my lab group.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Remember when I said I was having lab problems? It's because I'm in a group with Colt, Sam, and Denni.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And trust me when I say the three of them together makes chemistry lab difficult.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We just need to add some salt and water, use the filter paper, and examine our findings.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, I got the water. And the salt is...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The salt is right where Sam and Colt are... Making out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha ha. I can definitely light `your` Bunsen burner...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha. I can definitely light [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] Bunsen burner...

nodes.text: Colt and Sam kiss!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hot.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, this is awkward.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The thing is, no one in my lab is a problem individually, but combined they make lab impossible! And with this big test coming up soon, I'm worried.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I fail this test, my chemistry grade could really suffer. That's the only class holding me back from straight 'A+'s!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've worked really hard to be at the top of every class this year, but it'll all be for nothing if I get a 'B' in chemistry.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, maybe if you help them, your lab team can get along well enough to make it work.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, you're right. Today will be the day I'll make everyone work together.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You mean, you'll make some good chemistry?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha. Yes, exactly! Anyway, this class is mine. I'll see you later.
Ben enters the classroom and sits down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, Ben. Today's the day I can make that final push for an 'A'.
At that moment, Denni sits next to Ben and glumly puts her head on the desk.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Denni. Ready for our practice exam today?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not really.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Ben. I don't know if I can concentrate...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm kind of a wreck. Usually when I'm feeling this messed up, Raven makes me relax with an action movie and some tea...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But she's at college right now, and I'm just so upset.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry to do this to you, but... Can I tell you a secret?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow, Denni, um....

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You'll leave me alone if I tell you?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: For now...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay. The answer to the first problem is 13... The answer to the second problem is 7...
And a couple minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All triangles have four sides...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And there are 100 degrees in a right angle. I think that's it.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Just for helping me, I won't even stuff you into a locker.
Ryan runs off.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He does know that triangles have three sides, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know. I always tell bullies the wrong answers when they hassle me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And they don't beat you up?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If they find out. Which they don't.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I used to get picked on all the time until Colt taught me how to stand up to them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No way! I don't help people cheat.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You won't help me? Then no one's going to help `you` when I'm done.
nodes.text_bbcode: You won't help me? Then no one's going to help [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] when I'm done.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Pick on someone your own size!
Erik throws dirt in Ryan's eyes!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ow! Ugh, forgot about you! That trick won't work forever...
Ryan drops Ben and staggers away, swiping at the air while Ben and Erik take off down the hall.
A few lockers down...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for saving me. How'd you think of doing that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I used to get beat up a lot until Colt taught me how to stand up to the bullies.

nodes.title: Good Chemistry
nodes.subtitle: Help Ben reform his lab group!

nodes.text: Welcome to a new season at Centerscore High! In this episode, follow the adventures of Ben!
Who's Ben? Exactly! Ben's just a nerdy freshman who's kept his nose in books and his head down, trying to survive his first year of high school.
Classes are no trouble for him. All except one, that is...
Ben wants to ace chemistry, but it's hard when there's drama going on between your lab partners.
Can you help Ben pull his lab group together in time for the big test? Let's find out!
On the way to class...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wow, Ben, that's really cool! You're only a freshman, and you're already taking chemistry?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I took some science classes in middle school, so I could jump ahead and take chemistry sooner.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's one of my favorite subjects. Not as great as physics, but still pretty solid.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is chemistry hard?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The content is hard, but I'm having the most trouble with my lab group. See, it's like this...
Suddenly, Ryan appears and shoves Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, freshman nerd!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Not you. `Other` freshman nerd. I need you to tell me something.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not you. [color=#e23b3b][i]Other[/i][/color] freshman nerd. I need you to tell me something.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What should I talk about first? Your breath, your face, or the fact that you just crushed my windpipe?
Ryan lifts Ben off his feet and glares.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't care about your wind whatever instrument. You're in Mrs. Faulkner's first period math class.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I have the same math class next period, so you need to have math answers for me `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I have the same math class next period, so you need to have math answers for me [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nothing seems to be working... I'll never get that 'A' in lab class.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, wait, I can't give up now! Who should I talk to next?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All that's left is to talk to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All that's left is to talk to Denni.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All that's left is to talk to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But maybe all I need is `one` good lab partner.
nodes.text_bbcode: But maybe all I need is [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] good lab partner.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, so I didn't manage to fix everyone's problems...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That doesn't sound medical at all.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The thing is, Colt, you've been acting like a jerk to Sam the entire time.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course she's mad at you. You kissed another girl, and you're just shrugging it off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She broke up with you. You'll be lucky if she ever forgives you, much less gets back together with you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're right, I have been a jerk...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't even know what to say...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I have to think about all this, all right?
Colt leaves.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That went better than I thought.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A troubled soul?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What kind of crap is that? I'm not a troubled soul.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I `am` trouble.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] trouble.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I don't understand the point of all this. I wanted to win Sam over, and get her to not be mad at me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And this isn't helping. It's just a big waste of time.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Next time you want a guinea pig for your psycho experiments, don't ask me.
Colt leaves.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That went worse than I ever expected.
At Ben's house...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Isn't that what girls do? Can't we just go outside and punch things?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No. Talking will help me figure out why you can't see why Sam is mad at you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to talk about you. You want to get back into Sam's good graces, then you're going to have to figure some things out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay. What should I say?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know some exercises that psychologists use to better understand patients. Word association, for instance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This crap will really help me and Sam?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, fine. Let's start this thing. I haven't got all day.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll say a word, then you say the first word or phrase that pops into your head.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Steady.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, that wasn't one of the words... Start.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Running.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I want to get him to recognize things about his relationship with Sam. I should think about words related to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can help you get back into Sam's good graces.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We can figure out why she's so mad and make a plan to win her over.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, you have my attention.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So how are we going to do this?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have an idea...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `I` have nothing to 'get over'. Sam is the one who'll get over it.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] have nothing to 'get over'. Sam is the one who'll get over it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just keep telling yourself that.
Colt slams his elbow into Ben's gut!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `She'll get over it`, all right? Sam and I are `fine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]She'll get over it[/i][/color], all right? Sam and I are [color=#e23b3b][i]fine.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But if a brainiac like you wants to figure out why Sam's so frickin' mad at me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll feel less inclined to beat you up right now for being so stupid-looking.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Gulp... Of course.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great. So how are we going to do this, nerd?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have some ideas.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm so mad... Take that, Colt!
Sam punches the dummy five more times!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Hyah!` `Hyah!` `Hyah!` `Hyah!` `Hyah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hyah![/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]Hyah![/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]Hyah![/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]Hyah![/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]Hyah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Until at last, Sam sinks to the floor, exhausted.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Feel better?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, actually.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You done?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am. I am done.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, I'll walk you home.
Ben walks Sam back to her door.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are your arms going to be okay? You threw a lot of punches.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll be fine. I'm an athlete after all. And it felt good to get all that out. You make a convincing Colt...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just don't actually punch me. I don't know if I could handle it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha. Thanks for a great workout and a great time, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I can't imagine going through what you're going through. Must be tough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's nice to have someone understand that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben. And good night.
Sam lets herself into her house.
Sam suddenly drops her fists.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't do this anymore.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Want me to find another dummy? A punching bag? Something to throw?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. This just isn't working for me. It was... Interesting. But this isn't what I want to do.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Want to do something else?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I don't need your help anymore, Ben. I just want to be alone.
Sam leaves the gym, angrily shoving everything in her path.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Way to make her more mad, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where do I even begin with Colt? He needs to accept that Sam is really mad at him and wants to break up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need to get inside his head somehow.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Lucky that I've been taking that psychology elective in fifth period...
Ben finds Colt in the arcade playing 'Dead Nor Alive: Guns Versus Zombies' and approaches him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, don't do that, Zombie! Where'd you get that gun?!
The word 'DEAD' flash on the screen, and Colt turns angrily away.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Colt, just the guy I wanted to talk to.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I swear, it's like I have a sign on my forehead that says 'Nerds in Need of Mentoring Apply Here'.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't need a mentor.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever, nerd. Look, make your point.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Someone beating you up, and you want protection? I don't do these things for free.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want to talk to you about Sam.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Has she finally cooled off? She refuses to talk to me. I don't see what her problem is.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really? You don't?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It was just a kiss. It's not like I cheated on her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't even know where to start with that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And just what do you care anyway?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want to help.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you take me for, an idiot? No one's that charitable. What do you really want?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want an 'A' on that chemistry lab test. And frankly, you guys are making it very hard to get anything done. That's why I'm here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There it is. You're helping yourself. I guess I can respect that. But what's in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need to convince him to open up about Sam...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can help you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, the thing that happened with Denni...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was a mistake...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was definitely his mistake, but Colt didn't say it that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, the thing that happened with Denni...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was really fun...
Sam punches, nearly clipping Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, watch it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You watch it! What the heck are you saying, Ben?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, the thing that happened with Denni...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was an accident.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `An accident?!` `Hyah!` `Hyah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]An accident?![/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]Hyah![/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]Hyah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm almost glad Colt said it five hundred times, or I wouldn't have remembered it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, the thing that happened with Denni...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it that Colt said about kissing Denni? It was...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry I haven't called. I've been too busy roller skating...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Rollerskating', Ben? Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, that was lame, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry I haven't called. I've been too busy playing guitar...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He always did love that guitar more than me! `Hyah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: He always did love that guitar more than me! [color=#3b78e2][i]Hyah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's working!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry I haven't called. I've been too busy playing chess...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Playing chess', Ben? Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, that was lame, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nevermind. Moving on...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I should talk about something Colt does.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry I haven't called. I've been too busy...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can't call me that anymore! Hyah!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This seems to be working.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, dearest...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt would never call me that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, ignore that for now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, baby...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt would never call me that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, ignore that for now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Were you going to say something?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, let's forget that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But if you don't want to ask me out, then why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just a guy who wants to get an 'A' in his chemistry class.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ah. And that's hard with us fighting around you? Got it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So I wanted to check on you. With everything that's going on with Colt...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Don't talk about him.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Don't talk about him.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, sorry. I thought maybe you wanted to talk it out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know what? Why not? I can't go back to cheer practice anyway. Let's ditch this place.
Ben takes Sam to a gym a few blocks away from school.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where are we?
Around them, students in white gi spar. Along one wall sits a row of training dummies.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Welcome to the Just for Kicks Kickboxing Studio.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's a martial arts place.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought you wanted to talk.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I figure that you're pretty angry with C... Uh, I mean, with `him.` So would you rather talk about it... Or punch a dummy instead?
nodes.text_bbcode: I figure that you're pretty angry with C... Uh, I mean, with [color=#e23b3b][i]him.[/i][/color] So would you rather talk about it... Or punch a dummy instead?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Punching a dummy does sound like it'll be more satisfying.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know, right? Here's one.
Ben leads Sam over to one of the training dummies.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Go ahead. Punch it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hyah! Hyah! `Hyah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hyah! Hyah! [color=#3b78e2][i]Hyah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam punches the dummy three times.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... What do you think? Feel better?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is really nice, Ben, but... The dummy isn't Colt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, that's the point. You don't want to hit Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But the thing is... I `do` want to hit Colt. I want to deck him so hard that he won't be able to walk upright for a week.
nodes.text_bbcode: But the thing is... I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] want to hit Colt. I want to deck him so hard that he won't be able to walk upright for a week.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe we weren't the perfect couple, but I loved him. Knowing he cheated on me really hurts.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I want him to know how much.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That might get you into trouble. Tell you what. I'll stand behind and brace the dummy and pretend to be Colt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And maybe you can work more of your rage out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right. Let's try this.
Ben stands behind the dummy as Sam raises her fists.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right. What would Colt say? What does he call Sam?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're a really nice girl, Sam, and I'd be lucky to date you, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm more into nerdy girls, and you're popular and a cheerleader and all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh! That makes total sense. Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You got that right. I'm a cheerleader, you're a nerd.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm on top of the cheer pyramid, you're at the bottom of the social ladder.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm hot, and you're...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, wait right there. I get what you're saying.
Ben walks Denni back to her house.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This was really fun. I feel so much better. It really helped to take my mind off things.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You were so stressed out, and really, the entire situation's out of your hands at this point.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I see that now. Thanks for the entire evening, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No problem.
Denni hugs Ben!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Good night!
Ben drops Denni off at home.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I really appreciate you taking me out, Ben. I just wish I were better company.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm just so worried about what's going on at school, and I feel there's no way I can make things right again.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry to hear that, Denni.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guess I didn't do anything to help her relax at all!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm just going to go upstairs. Hopefully I'll get pneumonia, and then I won't have to show up at school for awhile.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aw, don't do that. Things will blow over.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Eventually. Good night, Ben. And thanks again.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sam is angry about the break-up. If I could think of a way to channel her aggression, she'd be fine.
Ben finds Sam on the football field, lining up for cheer practice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why are you standing here, Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is where I'm supposed to be.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Find a better spot, or you're going to be sorry.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Sam!` You can't threaten Jessica like that. She's in the right place. I assigned those positions for a reason!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam![/i][/color] You can't threaten Jessica like that. She's in the right place. I assigned those positions for a reason!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sam's way out of line!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `I'm` way out of line?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] way out of line?!

nodes.text: Sam lunges for Jessica, but $ZOE holds her back.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam, take five. We're a cheer team. We're supposed to be `cheerful.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, take five. We're a cheer team. We're supposed to be [color=#3b78e2][i]cheerful.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what? You've been arguing with me all day. I'm tired of it. Don't take five. Take the rest of practice.
Sam storms to the bench.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sam? Got a minute?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, come on. Really? You're going to ask me out now? I've only been single since the beginning of the week.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't you have any respect for me at all?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I'm not here to ask you out. You're...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do you mean? Of course it's my fault! I kissed Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know if I can forgive myself for doing that to Sam. I never thought I'd be the kind of person that steals boyfriends!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just wish there were a way of reversing things.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, if only.
Ben and Denni sit in thoughtful silence until they finish their drinks.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not that bad? I just broke up one of the most popular couples in school!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It sounds like you kissing Colt just kind of happened. Maybe it was a mistake, or maybe it was an accident.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I'm sure you didn't mean to hurt Sam. So it's not that bad. There are worse things you could've done.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, you could've run off together, gone to Vegas on his motorcycle, and gotten married. Then sent the pictures to Sam and posted them online.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeesh, that sounds pretty bad.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kissing him once doesn't look that bad now, does it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ha ha. Good point, Ben.
After some talking, Ben and Denni finish the drinks and head out.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So how are you feeling? About Sam and Colt, I mean.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sad that Sam and Colt are having so many problems.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I feel so responsible. I mean, if I hadn't kissed Colt...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What should I say?
Ben buys coffee and brings it to Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I like coffee, but sometimes it gets me `too` energized.
nodes.text_bbcode: I like coffee, but sometimes it gets me [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] energized.

nodes.text: Denni takes a sip. Five minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just don't know what to do about the entire thing! It's a mess! A mess! How will I ever make it up to Sam?
Denni jumps from her chair and paces the floor.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh! I know! I'll make Sam a card! A card with stickers. 'I'm Sorry' stickers. And it should have hearts!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, it shouldn't have hearts. It'll only remind her of what I did which I'm so sorry about. What have I done?
Twenty minutes later, Denni slumps back into her chair.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ugh, I think I'm crashing.
Denni puts her head down on the table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, caffeine is definitely not the drink for you.
Ben buys tea and brings it to Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is exactly what Raven would've made for me. Chamomile is really comforting. And it's supposed to induce sleep.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Glad I hit the nail on the head.
Ben buys a strawberry smoothie and hands it to Denni. She takes a large sip and swallows.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is so delicious. What is it? Raspberry? Blueberry?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Strawberry.
Denni stands suddenly, putting the drink on the table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... Cough... I'm allergic to strawberries! Cough...
Denni rushes to the bathroom.
A couple minutes later, Denni sits back at the table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, I'm sorry. Are you okay? Do we need to take you to the hospital?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No. I'll be fine. Lucky I had some allergy medication on me. And I'm the one who should be sorry...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm always messing things up. I should've known they'd put strawberries in a fruit smoothie. Stupid of me not to mention my allergies.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're not stupid, Denni. Anyone could've forgotten. Can I get you something else?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, it's fine. I'll just drink water.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How about we play some video games now? I brought my collection with me, unless there was something specific you wanted to play...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Can we play 'Zombies Eat Brains 2'?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The one where you fight against each other as zombies for brains?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah! It's my favorite game. I'm really good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think I've played before.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Tough to be you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm up for the challenge.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm just kidding. I'll go easy on you. And the game's pretty simple. All you have to do is punch, kick, or shoot your gun.
Ben sets up the game and hands Denni her controller.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm pretty good at games like this. I could probably still beat Denni. But maybe it's better to let her win?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I call Zombastic!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then I'll be Brain Biter!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's play!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's go for the action movie.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This will be so fun! That's the kind of movie Raven would've picked. She's not really a fan of cliche romances or French films.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great! Besides, I think you'll enjoy 'Rise of the Maskmaker'.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That sounds familiar... Is that from something?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe it's based off a game? But I mainly chose it because the action sequences are pretty cool.
Ben and Denni settle down to watch the movie.
A couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That was `awesome!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#3b78e2][i]awesome![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was better than I remembered! The way Hal took out the Maskmaker...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And Natalia is so pretty! Great movie choice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's go for the romantic drama.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you sure? Boys don't usually go for that stuff.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, but I figured you're smack in the middle of your own drama, so we might as well research it, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh yeah....
Ben and Denni settle down to watch the movie.
On a beach in the light of the moon...

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: You betrayed me for that horrible witch of a woman. You kissed her, Jojo!

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: I know, I know. But I was wrong. Jenni means nothing to me! She never has.

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: And she never will.

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: Ella, what does that mean? What did you do?

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Jojo, I was so angry... I... I may have done something we will both regret.

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: `What did you do?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What did you do?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: I. Shot. Her.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Eep!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Eep![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben stops the movie.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Denni, what's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Jojo cheated on Ella with Jenni, and Ella murdered her! That's what's wrong.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I helped Colt cheat. I'm a terrible person, and I'm going to get shot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guess I shouldn't have gone with romantic...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's go for the French film.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you sure? I didn't think you'd be into a documentary about food.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, but you'd probably enjoy it. Besides, I like soup.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay!
Ben and Denni settle down to watch the movie.
The movie ends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What'd you think, Denni?
Denni doesn't answer. Ben looks over and sees she's asleep.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh? I must've fallen asleep.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That bad, huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I am vegetarian... And it was a movie about the horrors of vegetarianism. I'll never look at carrots the same way again.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I had the worst dream that Sam came after me because of Colt!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guess I shouldn't have gone with the documentary...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This doesn't seem to be working at all!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I refuse to stop now!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hm... Next up is...
Next up is...
After school that day...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have three days before the lab final to make everyone get along. But where to start?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: First, I should talk to...
Great, but not quite `perfect.` Try again to unlock the bonus scene!

nodes.text: And don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Colt, you want to give it a try?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nah. This isn't really my thing. Who cares anyway?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...
Ben pours in the acid.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll handle that.
Sam angrily grabs a test tube, shaking the rack, and quickly pours the compounds into the beakers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You might want to slow down...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoops...
Sam overpours, and the chemicals spill to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'd better mop that up before someone slips.
Sam cleans as Ben grabs more supplies and mixes the beakers himself.
Ben and Denni go to the supply cabinet.
Ben tries to hand Denni some beakers, but she drops them on the floor!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry. I'll, um, clean that up.
Ben carries all the supplies to the table by himself.
On the day of the big lab final...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I hope all of you know what you're supposed to do... Begin!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nerd, what are we doing?
Ben consults his lab manual.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right, there are four things we have to do. The first step is that we need to get our beakers and fill them with the right chemicals.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now for the second step. We need to start adding this blue compound and this green compound to two different beakers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Third step. We just have to add this acid to each beaker. And we should start recording our results...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fourth step. We just have to add the universal indicator to each beaker.
Ben mixes the chemicals together...
The chemicals start bubbling, and the mixture starts to froth over!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that, uh, supposed to do that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, what's happening?!
The mixture keeps frothing until a foamy blanket fills the entire classroom!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm impressed. I didn't think this could be created with the materials we were using.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, Amanda, where are you?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Making snow angels! No one told me it would `snow` today!
nodes.text_bbcode: Making snow angels! No one told me it would [color=#3b78e2][i]snow[/i][/color] today!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ack! This is so gross!
From the foam, a tall figure obscured by suds emerges and looms over Ben and his lab group.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's the marshmallow man!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's a monster!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Worse... It's Mr. Russell.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Got that right. I already told you that if you didn't work out your problems, you wouldn't pass.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know, Mr. Russell. I tried to get them to work together...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: You're going to have to try harder. Starting tomorrow, I expect you four in this classroom after school every day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I have cheerleading practice!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And the environmental club volunteers on most days.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Well, no student is eligible for a club or sport when they're failing. And after this lab test, none of you are in the clear.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If I was ever in the clear.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell

nodes.text: I appreciate everything you tried to do, and I want you to know...

nodes.text: It's okay, Denni. You don't have to say it. I like you too.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are you doing?! I have nothing against you, Ben, but kissing random boys is how I got into my mess in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I was going to tell you that I was really glad you were my friend, but now I don't know what to think.
Denni runs off.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That was nothing short of a disaster, wasn't it?

nodes.text: Is it, uh, hot in here, or is that me?

nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.text: `Get out of the building! It's going to blow!`

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Over here, Ben! Let the National Investigator take your picture!

nodes.speaker: Reporter
nodes.text: Ben! Last year, there was a big explosion at your school that caused many of us to believe you and your lab group did not survive.

nodes.speaker: Reporter
nodes.text: But apparently you've been in hiding for the last year. Now you've finally revealed yourself, can you tell us what `really` happened at Centerscore?
nodes.text_bbcode: But apparently you've been in hiding for the last year. Now you've finally revealed yourself, can you tell us what [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] happened at Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good question. Good citizens, it is with much apprehension that I tell the real story about the Big Chemical Explosion of last year.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The chemicals that we were exposed to in lab that day mixed to create a substance that radically altered our DNA.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Over the last year, we've been coping with these abnormalities.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: While many of you may think these abnormalities are cool, I assure you they are not.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They are highly unstable and dangerous to the general populace.
Ben gestures at a girl wearing red on the stage.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is Spitting Fireballs, who was once known as Sam.
Sam's fingertips glow with red light, and she makes a fireball spark to life in her hand.
The audience 'ooh's and 'ahh's. Ben points to another figure on stage.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And this is Slither, who was once Colt. He can teleport at will and can disappear at the mere idea of any conflict.
Colt appears to teleport to different locations on the stage.
And Ben points to the last figure on stage.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And this is Dart who was once Denni, equipped with the power to dodge any attack and hide from plain sight.
Denni ducks as the audience applauds.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: With the aid of the government and some generous supporters, we are starting our own academy, Ben's School for the Gifted, where we will live in seclusion studying our powers and keeping them under control.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It will be a lonely existence, but it is for the good of mankind.
Super powers might be cool, but this is still a super bad ending for Ben.

nodes.text: So is there no chance then? You're not going to get over me kissing Denni, and we get to stay together?

nodes.text: Sorry, Colt. I'm still mad, and I don't know if I'll ever get over it.

nodes.text: Well, there's only so much you can do.

nodes.text: Come on, Ben. Let's get some coffee. This time, it's on me.

nodes.text: All right, I'm not a big fan of all this psychology stuff, but since Sam and I broke up, I'm willing to try it to get over her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And if you're going to let me 'study' with you for the chemistry final, I'm willing to be your test subject.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what do you want to do?

nodes.text: We could do an inkblot test, but I want to try something new. Past life regression.

nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Past-life regression is using hypnosis to channel your past lives.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That sounds dumb.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And my past life? How is that supposed to help me `right now` in the `present`?

nodes.text: And sometimes seeing your past is one way of figuring out issues.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.text: Just sit down and relax.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now, think of a calm place... A quiet place...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A calm place... A quiet place...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now think back to your distant past, Colt... What do you see?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahhhhh!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Colt, snap out of it!
